verdict.rationale: Notion advertises agents and instant cited answers, and its Agent APIs let users start chat sessions with Agents, stream replies and submit actions. Notion MCP lets natural-language clients like Claude Code or Cursor search, read, create and update workspace content, with reusable natural-language Skills for repeatable workflows. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what in-app agents can actually do (the agent and Q&A claims are only marketing taglines), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
